artworks.title: View of the River Rhine
artworks.artist: Jan van Aken after Herman Saftleven
artworks.description: The etching depicts an elevated view of a vast landscape. The horizon is high in the image, showing the sky meeting distant mountains. The lines in the engraving are detailed with crosshatching, creating textures in the clouds and terrain. On the left, there is foliage with a figure on horseback visible. Beyond, more figures and animals are seen on a path leading to a river with a docked boat. In the distance, the landscape includes hills and rocky formations. The color palette is monochromatic, enhancing depth and contrast. Swirling clouds fill the sky above scenes of nature and human activity.

artworks.title: View of the River Rhine
artworks.artist: Jan van Aken after Herman Saftleven
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the image, where the sea meets the sky. Rocky cliffs with some vegetation are visible along the horizon. The sky has soft, billowing clouds with delicate lines. The artwork is detailed with intricate linework and shading typical of an etching. It is rendered in black and white, emphasizing the contrasts. Figures are around small boats on the rocky shore, with trees on the sides. In the distance, some sails are visible on the water.

artworks.title: View of the River Rhine
artworks.artist: Jan van Aken after Herman Saftleven
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a valley, distant mountains, a village next to a body of water, and several figures in the foreground. Details include plants, intricate linework depicting figures and surroundings, a monochrome color palette of beige and dark brown, and swirling clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: La noed de cravate (Knotting the Cravat)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up engaging in an activity. The person on the left is turned slightly towards the other individual. She has a delicate facial profile with her hair styled up in a bun or knot. She wears a dark-colored dress or top with tight-fitting sleeves. The person on the right is facing left with short, tousled hair and wears a dark cap. He is wearing a light-colored shirt with faint polka dots and has an object in his mouth. Both individuals have no visible jewelry. The background is abstract with lines suggesting walls and furniture.

artworks.title: Charles-Gaspard-Guillaume de Vintimille du Luc, Archbishop of Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man from the waist up in a large chair. He has a round face, downturned eyes, gray curly hair, and is wearing religious attire. He holds a decorated hat with a tassel in one hand. The background includes heavy drapery with intricate patterns and a glimpse of a library or study to the right, with shelves of books and a writing desk with a quill and inkwell.

artworks.title: Jean Delpech, Marquis de Méréville
artworks.artist: Pierre Drevet after Nicolas de Largillierre
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man facing forward with his head turned slightly to the right. He has defined eyebrows, a straight nose, and a slight smile. The man has thick, curly hair that falls past his shoulders. He is wearing high-collared clothing with a pleated collar and a draped garment. The portrait is in an oval frame with engraved text, and below it is a decorative cartouche with a coat of arms featuring two crowned lions. The background displays a detailed landscape with trees.

artworks.title: Jean Paul Bignon, Abbe du St. Quentin
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the upper torso up. He faces slightly left with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has curly hair, a distinguished nose, and a slight smile. He wears a period-specific buttoned coat with a large collar. The frame around him shows inscriptions indicating his identity and titles. Below the oval frame is an emblem in a decorative cartouche. The background within the frame is plain, while the exterior has a detailed pattern.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Adoring the Christ Child
artworks.description: The image displays a man kneeling on the ground facing a seated woman and child on a cloud. The man has short hair with a beard, wearing a long robe tied at the waist, suggesting a monastic habit. His gaze is directed towards the child, with his hands raised towards the child's foot. The woman is seated on the cloud, holding the child. She has soft facial features with dark, wavy hair, draped in flowing robes. The child has curly hair, sitting on the woman's lap, reaching towards the man. In the clouds, there are cherubic faces and winged figures. In the background, there are mountains and valleys faintly depicted.

artworks.title: The Chariot of Diana
artworks.artist: Agostino dei Musi after Luca Penni
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chariot pulled by a pair of animals flying through the clouds. The chariot is elaborately decorated with intricate designs and winged wheels. The animals resemble dogs or wolves. Three figures inside the chariot wear classical garments, with one seemingly guiding the animals. A large sun is depicted behind them, radiating rays outward. Fluffy clouds surround the chariot and figures, giving the impression of elevation. Below is a landscape with a town, buildings, towers, and a winding river. The image is framed in an oval format and has detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's head and shoulders, drawn in profile facing left. His head is slightly tilted downward, showcasing his prominent nose, pointed beard and mustache, well-defined facial features, deeply set eyes, and pronounced brow lines. His hair appears short and slightly wavy. The man is wearing a garment with a high, softly folding collar. No jewelry or objects are present. The background is plain.

artworks.title: An Elaborate Staircase in a Palace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash
artworks.description: This is an image of an opulently decorated architectural interior. The drawing features a grand staircase with intricate details, surrounded by multiple layers of arches and staircases. The design includes classical architectural elements like Corinthian columns, decorative friezes, and sculptural figures on pedestals. The drawing uses shading and a restrained color palette to add depth to the scene. The level of detail in the drawing captures the grandeur and elegance of the architecture depicted.

artworks.title: The Fall of the Rebel Angels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk, and pen and black ink with gray wash; scattered unrelated touches of red chalk on left

artworks.title: Heads of Two Bishops
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed drawing of two men. The composition shows the upper bodies of the men close together. One man faces slightly to the side with facial features like a short beard and curly hair. The other man is in profile, wearing a distinctive large hat that may signify a position of religious authority. He has a longer, fuller beard. Both are dressed in garments with intricate patterns. The background is filled with cross-hatched lines for shading.

artworks.title: Bacchus and Ceres
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink; piece of paper added on left, with additional drawing by a later hand in ink of a different color
artworks.description: The image shows two figures seated closely together. The figure on the right holds a flute-like instrument pressed to their lips. The figure on the left rests their hand on the instrument with eyes closed. Both figures have intricate facial features, with one showing a more pronounced profile. The figure on the left has wavy hair adorned with leaves and flowers, as well as elements of nature. The background is textured, resembling a natural or cave-like setting with patterns and lines filling the space.

artworks.title: Echo and Narcissus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over black chalk, partly indented with stylus
artworks.description: This is a classical mythological scene set in a natural landscape. The drawing depicts intertwined figures among rocks and vegetation. The central figures appear to be floating or ascending. The background includes trees and rocks with intricate details. The use of delicate and nuanced lines in the drawing reflects classical styles.

artworks.title: Felled Tree, Normandy
artworks.medium: charcoal with red-brown and yellow crayon
artworks.description: The image features a fallen tree trunk extending horizontally across the scene. The horizon line is suggested by a cluster of trees in the distance. The style is characterized by precise pencil strokes outlining the trunk and branches with shading for depth. The color palette includes earth tones, with browns, grays, and hints of orange in the leaves. The ground has a pale yellow tint with grass strokes. In the background, there is a dense growth of trees forming a textured wall.

artworks.title: The Sea Off the Edge of a Boat, Brittany
artworks.description: The image shows turbulent water, possibly waves or a rushing river, from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is not visible. A solid, diagonal line on the left side may represent a bridge or a constructed barrier. Expressive pencil strokes capture the dynamic patterns and textures of the water. The monochromatic gray scale of the image creates a somber mood. Contrasting dark and light pencil marks enhance the movement and energy of the water's surface, conveying a sense of motion.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash,  heightened with white, on paper washed salmon
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body drawing of a person standing in a somewhat frontal position, slightly angled to the right. The person has a somber expression with soft facial features, including delicately arched eyebrows and a gentle, relaxed mouth. The hair is styled in loose curls framing the face. The clothing consists of flowing robes with voluminous sleeves and drapery that cascades down to the feet, rendered in soft, sweeping lines. The person is holding a crescent-shaped object in each hand. The background consists of a simple, unadorned texture.

artworks.title: Abraham and Isaac
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two figures in an outdoor setting. One figure is a man in a long coat and hat, while the other figure appears to be a child holding a container. A tall, bent tree stands between them, leading the eye upwards. In the background, there is a village with a steeple on the horizon. Surrounding the village are loosely sketched buildings and foliage in muted shades of gray and brown. The sky is lightly clouded with gentle strokes indicating a peaceful, natural environment.

artworks.title: Curled up Girl on Bed
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person lying down, with only the upper body shown. The person appears to be covered by a blanket and is lying on their side, facing the viewer's left. The sketch shows minimal facial features and loose hair scribbles. The person is covered with a blanket or sheet, and part of the head and neck are exposed. No jewelry or objects are visible, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Omer Talon
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Samuel H. Kress Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person showing the upper half of the body. The individual is sitting and facing forward, with a direct gaze towards the viewer. The person has light, slightly wavy hair that is of moderate length, along with distinctive facial features that include a firm expression and pronounced cheekbones. The individual is dressed in traditional attire featuring a high-collared garment with a visible bow tie and a pleated, textured cloak-like garment over it. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background is a textured, octagonal frame that surrounds the figure.

artworks.title: The Small Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Raphael Sadeler I after Matthias Grünewald
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Samuel H. Kress Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a man on a cross, surrounded by three people in robes. The background shows a rocky landscape with trees under a dark sky.

artworks.title: Study of Jove and Three Goddesses
artworks.medium: graphite with brown and red wash on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of seated figures in an abstract scene. The central figure is seated, surrounded by other figures. The drawing uses pencil and light washes of red and brown. The main figure in the center is detailed, with a muscular torso and wearing a draped garment. There are at least four other figures with varying degrees of detail around the central figure. The drawing is enclosed in a roughly sketched oval boundary and contains swirling lines and shading.

artworks.title: Scenes from the Life of Saint Peter
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (corners rounded): 35 x 22.9 cm (13 3/4 x 9 in.)
artworks.description: The sketch features multiple full-body figures in flowing garments. The figures in the upper section are standing and appear to be mostly women, with wavy hair and draped clothing. There is a variety of positions among the figures, with some facing forward and others in profile. The figures have simple facial contours, with limited emphasis on detailed facial expressions. Around them, additional sketch lines hint at movement and spatial dynamics. In the lower section, a group of people appears to be engaged in a discussion or interaction; they are also in flowing robes, with some figures gesturing. The background consists of beige paper with handwritten numbers and letters at the top right. The drawing emphasizes gestural line work and a mix of soft and bold line strokes, suggesting a preliminary conceptual art piece, with no intricate background detailing beyond the figures.
